summary: Regenerate cells after rejected model envelopes

delivery.outcome: Regenerate whole files after rejected model file envelopes or contract headers while retaining the original answer and bounded budget.
nonGoals: No retry of provider failures or network errors
No oracle, contract or function-body repair by the controller
No managed standard or foreign worktree edits

architecture.decision: Classify model envelope/header rejections separately, retain the original proposal in the private attempt audit, and feed the rejection into the existing bounded whole-file loop. Provider errors keep their existing fail-stop behavior.

dataChanges.description: Retain the original model bundle in the existing private per-attempt audit; no data migration or ownership transfer.

architecture.rollback: Independent reviewed revert; preserve original audit evidence.

validation.evidence: Wrong file-key and conflicting header answers retry with the original answer and exact failure retained; only a qualified candidate is published.
Exhaustion keeps the attempt budget and publishes nothing; provider faults stop after one call; all existing regression cases pass.
Required native CI and governance pass; independent exact-head Validator approval and merge.
